hooks.command: jq -r '(.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.notebook_path // empty)' | { read -r f; [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR") printf '%s' "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"AGENTS.md requires a worktree, a branch and a draft PR before the first edit (see Working on the issue board). This path resolves inside the canonical clone ($CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR), not an isolated worktree. Run: git worktree add ../wattroom-worktrees/<slug> -b <type>/<slug>  from $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, then edit inside that worktree instead.\"}}" ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.go) gofmt -w "$f" ;; */web/*) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/web" && pnpm exec prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
